title: D-006 Section 3/5.2 edits: ORCHESTRATION_POLICY model-tiering amendment + code-graph awareness lines in eight agent definitions
objective: Apply exactly the .claude/ edits D-006 authorizes (D-006-R017/R018/R027, source-001.md Sections 3, 5.2, 7): (1) add the Section 3 model-tiering amendment text to .claude/ORCHESTRATION_POLICY.md (spawn-level mechanical-sweep tiering, sweep identity progress-auditor by default, data-not-judgment boundary, dispatch naming/scope/report-split rules, gate-class never on a lower model, never downgrade judgment); (2) add the Section 5.2 one-sentence code-graph awareness line to the eight named agent definitions - backend-engineer, frontend-engineer, code-reviewer, security-reviewer, qa-engineer, rules-engineer, geospatial-engineer, data-contract-verifier - with the read-only reviewer variant (--no-regen; stale cache reported, never regenerated) for code-reviewer, security-reviewer, and data-contract-verifier. .claude/hooks/**, .claude/rules/**, .claude/settings.json, .claude/settings.local.json, CLAUDE.md (no hook/settings/rules change; no effort key anywhere, D-004 standing hold)

acceptance_scenarios: AS-1 (executable): git diff --name-only for the task's contribution touches ONLY the eight named .claude/agents/*.md files, .claude/ORCHESTRATION_POLICY.md, and the packet/report paths; no new file under .claude/agents/; no hooks/settings/rules/skills change; no effort key anywhere (grep for 'effort' in the diff finds no new key).

AS-2: each of the eight agent definitions contains exactly one added code-graph awareness sentence carrying 'advisory only' and citing tools/code_graph/README.md; the three read-only reviewers' sentences additionally carry --no-regen and the report-not-regenerate rule (D-006-R017/R018).

AS-3: .claude/ORCHESTRATION_POLICY.md carries the Section 3 tiering amendment preserving verbatim-critical constraints: sweep identity = existing auditor-class definition (default progress-auditor); data-not-judgment boundary; dispatch names each sweep spawn, model, exact scope; gate-class reviewer identities never on a lower model; never downgrade judgment to save tokens (D-006-R008..R014).
